description: This PHP file defines the GenericRestController class, which handles REST API requests for different endpoints in the OrangeHRM system. It manages GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE requests by dynamically instantiating API endpoint classes based on request attributes and routing the requests accordingly. The class enforces certain interface implementations for endpoints and provides validation rule integration.

classes.name: GenericRestController
classes.description: A controller class that handles REST API requests for various resources, routing them to appropriate endpoint classes based on request attributes, and managing CRUD operations with validation.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the endpoint object based on the request attribute '_api' and verifies its type.

methods.name: handleGetRequest
methods.description: Handles GET requests, fetching either a single resource or collection based on request parameters.

methods.name: initGetValidationRule
methods.description: Determine validation rules for GET requests depending on whether it's a single resource or collection.

methods.name: handlePostRequest
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create new resources via the endpoint.

methods.name: initPostValidationRule
methods.description: Sets validation rules for resource creation.

methods.name: handlePutRequest
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update existing resources.

methods.name: initPutValidationRule
methods.description: Sets validation rules for resource updates.

methods.name: handleDeleteRequest
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove resources.

methods.name: initDeleteValidationRule
methods.description: Sets validation rules for resource deletion.

methods.name: getNotInstanceOfException
methods.description: Utility method to generate an exception if the endpoint is not of the expected class.

methods.name: isGetOneRequest
methods.description: Determines if the current request is for a single resource.

methods.name: getPreparedResponseParamsFromResult
methods.description: Prepares response data including the result, meta, and relations for API responses.
